summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting completion of a previously disclosed private placement on October 16, 2026. The company issued 20,338,974 common shares to purchasers for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $24.0 million, before offering expenses, implying roughly $1.18 per share. The outside date had been extended from September 29 to October 16, 2026. All purchase prices were received in full. This is an ordinary private financing closing, not a special situation. Watch for dilution impact, share overhang, and any registration-rights resale filing.
